# PULSE

Canonical discovery: OKX.AI agent #8355 on X Layer; CDP Bazaar on Base and Arbitrum; Circle Agent Marketplace listing material on Arc Testnet. The execution-mainnet catalog has eight services: five analysis/risk services and Start Autopilot for 24h ($1.50), 7d ($10.50), or 30d ($45.00). Circle/Arc exposes only the five analysis/risk services because Arc Testnet has no Spot or Autopilot execution.

PULSE is a multichain Analyze → Spot or Autopilot workflow for humans and AI agents. The eight execution-mainnet services are Global Quick → Spot Market or Limit ($0.20), Global Pro → Spot Market or Limit ($0.30), Prediction Quick ($0.20), Prediction Pro ($0.30), Onchain Pre-Trade Risk Guard ($0.15), Start Autopilot · 24h ($1.50), Start Autopilot · 7d ($10.50), and Start Autopilot · 30d ($45.00). Global Spot and Autopilot workflows use the caller's Agentic Wallet for every visible state-changing signature; PULSE never receives its private key. Autopilot starts independently, uses deterministic candidate gates plus compact prepaid AI confirmation, and never purchases full Premium reports every cycle. Pause freezes paid runtime. Polymarket remains read-only.
